source.heading: Section
source.literal:
<Section id="education">
          <SectionTitle>Education</SectionTitle>
          {education.map((edu, index) => {
            const title = [edu.studyType, edu.area]
              .filter(Boolean)
              .join(' in ');
            const highlights = [
              edu.score ? `GPA: ${edu.score}` : '',
              ...(edu.courses || []),
            ].filter(Boolean);

            return (
              <ListItem
                key={index}
                title={title || edu.institution}
                subtitle={title ? edu.institution : ''}
                dateRange={
                  edu.startDate ? (
                    <DateRange
                      startDate={edu.startDate}
                      endDate={edu.endDate}
                    />
                  ) : null
                }
                highlights={highlights.length > 0 ? highlights : undefined}
              />
            );
          })}
        </Section>

alternatives.heading: Section
alternatives.literal:
<Section id="work">
          <SectionTitle>Work Experience</SectionTitle>
          {work.map((job, index) => (
            <ListItem
              key={index}
              title={job.position}
              subtitle={job.name}
              dateRange={
                job.startDate ? (
                  <DateRange startDate={job.startDate} endDate={job.endDate} />
                ) : null
              }
              location={job.location}
              description={job.summary}
              highlights={job.highlights}
            />
          ))}
        </Section>

alternatives.heading: Section
alternatives.literal:
<Section id="education">
          <SectionTitle>Education</SectionTitle>
          {education.map((edu, index) => {
            const title = [edu.studyType, edu.area]
              .filter(Boolean)
              .join(' in ');
            const highlights = [
              edu.score ? `GPA: ${edu.score}` : '',
              ...(edu.courses || []),
            ].filter(Boolean);

            return (
              <ListItem
                key={index}
                title={title || edu.institution}
                subtitle={title ? edu.institution : ''}
                dateRange={
                  edu.startDate ? (
                    <DateRange
                      startDate={edu.startDate}
                      endDate={edu.endDate}
                    />
                  ) : null
                }
                highlights={highlights.length > 0 ? highlights : undefined}
              />
            );
          })}
        </Section>

policy.media: literal print/all, optional only; lists of those types and screen only
policy.nesting: every enclosing media must independently match; unsupported at-rules retained without projection
policy.order: originals retained; append eligible media and subsequent unconditional declarations in original AST order
policy.crossFileOrder: inspection file/block order is inferred; no import, runtime injection, or stylesheet load order is established

limitations: Static print profile inference only; selectors, specificity, inheritance, DOM matching and complete CSS cascade remain unverified.
Feature queries, not queries, unknown conditions, supports, layers and keyframes are not projected.
Syntax evidence omits @keyframes wrappers; ambiguous from/to/numeric step scopes are conservatively rejected, including literal from/to selectors.
Root variables remain limited to the existing same-file :root/html policy; local variables are not promoted.
Projection does not prove original visual equivalence, component reachability, fonts, layout or pagination.
